ability.name: Intense Piety
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Priest^^** or **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Legendary Tenacity
ability.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Hour of Glory
ability.effect: This unit can be picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability even if it has already used it this battle. In addition, when this unit is picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.
